CORRECTION FOR campaign/the-burr, AND IT CHANGES THE WORK. The bounce notice on this board said the 25 conflicts were "mostly regenerated goldens", clearable by an absorb plus `make rebaseline` and `make rebaseline-goldens`. Re-measured against CURRENT main d0a31781 (the-burr now 62 ahead / 236 behind, merge-base 0c37a4c3): still exactly 25 conflicts, but THREE ARE HAND-WRITTEN SOURCE and no rebaseline path touches them.

  git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only origin/main origin/campaign/the-burr | grep '^CONFLICT'

  13 -> `make rebaseline` (docs/generated-paths.txt): book/src/gallery/* x10, book/src/reference/dictionary-generated.md, clients/game/core/tests/fixtures/* x2
   9 -> `make rebaseline-goldens` (Makefile:603-609): cli/tests/fixtures/world-seed-42.json, windows/scene/tests/fixtures/* x3, windows/vessel/tests/fixtures/* x4, windows/worldgen/tests/fixtures/solitary-tongue-peoples-lexicons-seed-42.txt
   3 -> NEITHER, and all three are two-sided:
       windows/book/src/lib.rs             burr +546/-345  vs main  +36
       windows/lab/src/metrics.rs          burr  +59/-5    vs main +359/-10
       windows/worldgen/tests/exposure.rs  burr  +54/-18   vs main +143/-16

Measured with `git diff --shortstat <merge-base> <side> -- <file>`. The count was right; the characterisation was not. Resolve those three by hand FIRST — a rebaseline run over an unresolved tree regenerates from the wrong source and buries the real merge under regenerated bytes.

INCIDENTAL: `git merge-tree` in this repo prints cargo/type-audit output to stdout ahead of its own result, because .gitattributes routes six generated docs through the merge=hv-regenerate driver (scripts/merge-regenerate.sh). Harmless to the mouth, which greps ^CONFLICT — but anything parsing merge-tree stdout POSITIONALLY will read the cargo banner as the tree OID.
